[[King Frozenwind]] is an [[non-player character|NPC]] involved in the [[quest]] [[Servants of Grenth]]. He spawns close to the statue of [[Grenth]] in the [[Ice Wastes]] and summons [[Ice Elemental]]s to defend himself.

==Dialogue==
:''"I've lived as a nameless king for far too long. The time has come to make myself known and perhaps reveal the dark secret which plagues this land."''

== Notes ==
* Don't let enemies kill King Frozenwind; his death causes the quest to fail and the party is kicked out of the Underworld.

== Trivia ==
* He is named after the player [[User:Frozenwind|Daniel Frozenwind]].
* Prior to [[Game updates/20091022#Guild Wars Wiki notes|October 22, 2009]], this NPC was named "Ice King."
* Though he is a [[Monk]], he only uses [[Elementalist]] skills.
* It was one of the bosses during the quest [[Battle for the Keep]] during the E3 2003 beta event. Survivors received a t-shirt with [https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/GuildWars.com_news/Archives/200305#May_19th,_2003 this art].
